div.p: Auto-detect sensitive fields. Hide from capture. Show to user.
User sees typed content in the mirror overlay
Capture sees grey box over every sensitive field
No capture exclusion API on X11 or Wayland. Overlay visible to both user and capture.

Financial: CC, CVV, IBAN, routing, SWIFT Identity: SSN, passport, driver license, tax ID Auth: password, API key, token, OTP, 2FA, PIN Hebrew: ת.ז, תעודת זהות, כרטיס אשראי, סיסמה, קוד אבטחה Custom: user-defined keywords via settings ControlTypes: Edit, Document, ComboBox, Custom, List, Text
Discord, Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, OBS Studio, Skype, Slack, Snipping Tool, Xbox Game Bar, PrintScreen
ALL capture APIs (BitBlt, DXGI, Windows.Graphics.Capture) go through DWM. WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE is enforced at compositor level.
